Portfolio

Valentina Ferrer is a fashion icon, model, and former Miss Argentina. She has graced the pages of publications such as Vogue Latinoamérica, Harper’s Bazaar Spain, Marie Claire Colombia and fronted campaigns for brands including Willy Chavarria and Tiffany & Co., captivating a global audience with particular resonance in Latin America. She has built a massive following of over 5.9M across Instagram and TikTok with whom she shares authentic glimpses of her distinct personal style, fashion career, and family life. Brand partners include Loewe, Carolina Herrera, Burberry, Victoria’s Secret, Printemps, Alo, Bimba y Lola, and more.
